title: pretty LAYLAH|Plus Size Pleated A-Line Shiny Belt Chiffon Formal Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Radiate elegance in our dress. This stunning dress features a flattering pleated A-line silhouette and a shiny belt that cinches the waist, enhancing your curves. Crafted from lightweight chiffon, it ensures comfort and a graceful flow. Perfect for formal events, this dress combines sophistication and style, making you the center of attention.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor Length.


Sleeve Style: Short Sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
